name: Cockpit
author: ReidenXerx
description: One hub for what the machine is doing right now: which AI sessions are working, waiting for you or done (and a finished chat back in one click), file transfers with real progress, long-running jobs, repos with work on one disk only, listening ports and the processes behind them, network links and connected devices. Extensible with your own providers.

barWidget.description: At-a-glance status hub: agents, transfers, jobs, git, ports, network, devices

schema.label: Rows per section
schema.description: How many rows each section shows before it is collapsed behind a count. Click a heading to see the rest.

schema.label: Refresh every (seconds)
schema.description: How often the hub re-runs its providers while it is open. Each provider also declares its own cadence, so an expensive one is not re-run just because this ticked.

schema.label: Notify me about agents
schema.description: A notification when a Claude Code session starts waiting for you, or finishes a turn that took more than a minute, unless its window is the one you are in. Show takes you there.
